'''Ander Rendrake''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], who served in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], he became a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].

==Biography==
Ander Rendrake was born around [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]] and he eventually enrolled in the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academy]]. He was two classes behind [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and the two became good friends.

After graduating he joined the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] however he became disenchanted with the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] and in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] he contacted Solo and joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. He was asked to stay within the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as a deep cover operative.

After the Battle of Yavin Rendrake was a [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] and served as a communications officer aboard the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Vendetta (Imperial-class)/Legends|''Vendetta'']]. He used his access to Imperial communications to supply Alliance operatives with whatever information he discovered. He also operated a [[Black market/Legends|black market]] of the ''Vendetta'', supplying other officers and enlisted troops with items that were hard to come by.

==Personality and traits==
Rendrake was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and was 29 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old by 0 BBY. He had a roguish personality and used his black market dealings as a way to cover his covert actions.

==Skills and abilities==
Although Rendrake was not an exceptional officer, he was skilled at using communications equipment and was able to feed data to Alliance operatives while keeping his actions hidden.

==Equipment==
Rendrake carried a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] and [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] around with him. He also had a full set of pass codes and [[Code cylinder/Legends|code cylinders]] and could gain access to any part of the ''Vendetta''. Through his black market contacts he could also get access to all sorts of contraband that he used to barter with the other ship's crewmen.

==Behind the scenes==
Ander Rendrake was designed by [[Sean Patrick Fannon]] for ''[[Cracken's Rebel Operatives]]'', a supplement for the ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' that was published by [[West End Games]] in [[1994]]. He was illustrated by [[Doug Shuler]].
